The '''J4-SN Chef Droid''' was a model of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|floating]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used as a [[Cooking droid/Legends|cooking droid]] by [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] members [[Gaboorga]] the Abundant and [[Duuba]] the Magnanimous during the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[3626 BBY]]. J4-SN Chef Droids were commonly plated in a [[Color/Legends|gold]] coloration, with a blue [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]] and four multipurpose appendages. It was also possible to attach a large custom [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Hat/Legends|hat]] on top of them. [[The Sarlacc Pit]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and [[Bog's Bounty Banquet Hall]] [[Head Chef Droid]] was a J4-SN Chef Droid.<ref name="Feast" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The J4-SN Chef Droid was first introduced during the Feast of Prosperity event within the [[2019]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' expansion for [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', playing a key role in the event's "Cantina Rush" and "Cooking" Mini-games. The J4-SN Chef Droid's hat is modeled to resemble a real-world [[Wikipedia:Chef's uniform|chef's]] [[Wikipedia:Toque|Toque]].<ref name="Feast" />
